items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: I didn’t love him. No. We were very compatible, Frank and I. Incidentally we were the only two Italians in the band.

ctx.x: So what kind of schedule did the Harry James band have when they first started out? I mean did you go right into like really on the road type stuff?

We went right to the Benjamin Franklin Hotel in Philadelphia. That was the first appearance. And from there we just did a gang of one nighters, you know, one night stands. And we came back to New York to The Roseland Ballroom and let’s see I started in January, and Frank Sinatra joined us in May. And I remember Harry said, Harry told me about him somewhere along the way, when we were at the Paramount Theatre. He says, “Jack you want to take a ride with me after the last show? I’m going to go see, there’s a kid…

downstairs before we went into the pit, and Harry introduced him, and they had already signed a contract. Harry says, “Fellas, I want you to meet our new vocalist, Frank Sinatra, and we’ll meet him singly afterwards” you know because we had to go into the pit. And so from that engagement, the next engagement was New Haven, Connecticut and that’s where Frank joined us and Harry introduced him there, and said, “Ladies and gentlemen I’d like to introduce you to our — have you meet our new vocalist, who we don’t have…
